posts.text: The new plant has started operations but they lost a few months so the results will be H2 heavy and I have also noticed they’ve developed proprietary AI software named Rail Intel to help make it easier to bid for orders on the portal In other updates 20 cr worth of orders have been received which takes the order book to 170 cr
